feature_key.description: Stable unique machine-readable feature identifier, such as ce_training_portal, ce_cohorts, ce_practitioner_workspace, time_tracking, client_portal, assessments, ai_tools, advanced_reporting, or custom_roles.

feature_name.description: Human-readable feature name shown in future plan and account administration screens.

description.description: Plain-language explanation of what this platform feature enables.

feature_category.description: Platform area this feature belongs to.

supports_limit.description: True when this feature may have an organization-specific numeric limit, such as seats, clients, cohorts, storage, or AI usage.

limit_label.description: Human-readable label for the limit when supports_limit is true, such as Employee Seats, Client Records, CE Cohorts, or Trainer Seats.

is_billable_add_on.description: True when this feature may be sold separately from a base plan.

is_active.description: Controls whether this feature may be included in new plans or organization entitlements.

sort_order.description: Display order for future platform plan and feature administration screens.
